claims: The prefix "cyber" originates from the Greek verb kybernan.
The Greek verb kybernan means "to pilot" or "to steer".
The Greek verb kybernan also gives us the word "cybernetic".
Common cyber attacks include phishing, malware, ransomware, and Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks.
Ransomware involves holding data for money.
Cyber-warfare integrates digital intelligence and operations with traditional military functions.
According to the FBI's 2025 Internet Crime Report, data theft causes over $16 billion in losses.
CYBER.ORG provides education to build cybersecurity career pathways.
